note: Every source this pack is built from, with the digests and sizes measured on 2026-10-10.
`evidence.quote` is the exact sentence the licence was read from, on `evidence.url`;
a source without one is not used, and the builder verifies every download against `sha256`.
Solar System Scope's own page credits NASA's Blue Marble as one of its inputs; the Earth maps
here are NASA's own files, used directly, and the ten Solar System Scope maps are used where
NASA's equivalent global mosaics are multi-hundred-megabyte simple-cylindrical GeoTIFFs.
